div.font:
Record count — version cmd ⇒ expect exactly 1 record; else log-scaled
Field richness — more fields/record = richer extraction (10+ ⇒ full)
Population rate — % of cells actually filled (non-empty)
Consistency — fields uniformly filled/empty across all records
